<P STYLE="font: 22pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; color: #7ab800">WM Announces Third Quarter 2026
Earnings</P>

<P STYLE="font: 22pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center; color: #7ab800"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">Strong Cash Flow from Operations Supports Return
of $957 Million to Shareholders During the Quarter</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">Healthcare Solutions Increases Income from Operations
by $41 Million<BR>
Driven by 3.7% Revenue Growth and Growing Cost Improvements</P>

<P STYLE="font: 12pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; text-transform: uppercase; vertical-align: baseline"><B>Houston</B></FONT><B>
&mdash; October 27<FONT STYLE="vertical-align: baseline">, 2026 </FONT></B>&mdash; WM (NYSE: WM) today announced financial results for
the quarter ended September 30, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="color: #57584F; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; color: windowtext">&ldquo;</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; color: black">WM
delivered another quarter of solid operating and financial performance, in line with our expectations, underscoring the consistent execution
of our strategy,</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; color: windowtext">&rdquo; said Jim Fish, WM&rsquo;s CEO. &ldquo;</FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt; color: black">Adjusted
operating EBITDA increased 5.8% in the third quarter driven by strong price-to-cost spread in Collection and Disposal and growing contributions
from our healthcare and sustainability businesses. Notably, Healthcare Solutions revenue grew 3.7% in the quarter and operating EBITDA
increased more than 30%, driven by effective cost management, synergy capture, and pricing growth. Overall, our results reflect the earnings
power of our diversified business and our ability to consistently create value for shareholders.&rdquo;</FONT><FONT STYLE="color: black"><SUP>(</SUP></FONT><SUP>a)</SUP></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Fish continued, &ldquo;The quality of our earnings
is evident in the strength of our cash flow generation. Net cash flow from operations increased 12% through the first nine months of
the year, reflecting disciplined operational execution and continued strong returns on investments that are improving productivity, enhancing
service and supporting sustainable long-term growth. We are affirming our 2026 guidance ranges, as we remain on track to meet our financial
objectives.&rdquo;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: red"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase; vertical-align: baseline"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; color: red">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase; vertical-align: baseline"><B>KEY
HIGHLIGHTS FOR the Third quarter OF 2026 </B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD>Total
                                            Company revenue grew 6.3%, driven by core price of 5.8% and Collection and Disposal yield
                                            of 3.4%. In addition to disciplined execution on pricing, revenue growth was driven by increased
                                            energy surcharges and higher volumes in the recycling and renewable energy businesses as
                                            a result of completed growth projects.<SUP>(e)(f)</SUP></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD>Collection
                                            and Disposal volume declined 0.4%, or declined 0.5% on a workday adjusted basis. Volumes
                                            continued to be impacted by the Company&rsquo;s intentional shedding of lower-margin residential
                                            business and commercial declines largely related to prior national account broker losses.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD>Operating
                                            expenses were 59.8% of revenue, compared to 58.9% in the prior year. Operating efficiency
                                            in the Collection and Disposal business drove a 40-basis point improvement, which was more
                                            than offset by dilutive impacts of 130 basis points primarily related to higher fuel costs and increased risk management costs.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"></P>

    <!-- Field: /Page -->

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD>SG&amp;A
                                            expenses were 9.6% of revenue, or 9.3% on an adjusted basis, an improvement of 70 basis points
                                            both on a reported and adjusted basis from the prior year, reflecting strong cost discipline
                                            and continued synergy capture in Healthcare Solutions.<SUP>(a)</SUP></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD>Favorable
                                            price-to-cost spread in the Collection and Disposal business contributed 40 basis points
                                            to adjusted operating EBITDA margin, and Healthcare Solutions operating performance added
                                            another 30 basis points. These contributions were more than offset by  40 basis points
                                            related to higher fuel costs and  40 basis points related to increased risk management
                                            costs. Overall, adjusted operating EBITDA margin compressed by 10 basis points
                                            compared to the prior year period. <SUP>(a)</SUP></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD>Through
                                            the first nine months of the year, the Company generated $4.87 billion of net cash provided
                                            by operating activities. The 12.0% increase from the prior year was driven by earnings growth
                                            and favorable working capital.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD>Through
                                            the first nine months of the year, free cash flow was $3.01 billion, compared to $2.11 billion
                                            in the prior year period, an increase of more than 42%. Conversion of adjusted operating
                                            EBITDA to free cash flow was 50% in the first nine months of the year.<SUP>(a)</SUP></TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD>The
                                            Company returned $957 million to shareholders in the third quarter, consisting of $580 million
                                            in share repurchases and $377 million in cash dividends, bringing returns to shareholders
                                            in the first nine months of the year to more than $2.72 billion, which is more than 90% of
                                            free cash flow generated during the period and reflects the Company&rsquo;s commitment to
                                            harvesting the benefits of its investments. Through the first nine months of the year, the
                                            Company repurchased $1.58 billion of its shares and continues to expect to repurchase a total
                                            of $2 billion of its shares in 2026.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD>During
                                            the quarter, the Company began operations at a new renewable natural gas facility in New
                                            York, marking its eighteenth new facility completed since 2022.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top"><TD STYLE="width: 20px"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 20px">&#8226;</TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-size: 11pt">The
                                            Company expects to achieve its full-year financial guidance, </FONT>with revenue expected
                                            to be at the high end of the guidance range of $26.275 to $26.475 billion, adjusted operating
                                            EBITDA to be within the guidance range of $8.15 to $8.25 billion, and free cash flow to be
                                            at the high end of the guidance range of $3.75 to $3.85 billion.<SUP>(a)</SUP></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

                                            The average price received for natural gas was $2.56 per MMBtu during the quarter compared
                                            to $2.46 per MMBtu in the prior year period. The average price received for electricity was about

<P STYLE="font: 6pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><I>&nbsp;</I></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>about wm</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="background-color: white">WM (<FONT STYLE="color: rgb(122,184,0)"><U>WM.com</U></FONT>)
is North America's leading provider of comprehensive environmental solutions. Previously known as Waste Management and based in Houston,
Texas, WM is driven by commitments to put people first and achieve success with integrity. WM, through its subsidiaries, provides collection,
recycling and disposal services to millions of residential, commercial, industrial, medical and municipal customers throughout the U.S.
and Canada. With innovative infrastructure and capabilities in recycling, organics and renewable energy, WM provides environmental solutions
to and collaborates with its customers in helping them pursue their sustainability goals. In North America, WM has the largest disposal
network and collection fleet, is the largest recycler and is a leader in beneficial use of landfill gas, with a growing network of renewable
natural gas plants and the most landfill gas-to-electricity plants, as well as the largest heavy-duty natural gas truck fleet in the
industry. WM, through its subsidiaries, also provides collection and disposal services of regulated medical waste and secure information
destruction services in the U.S., Canada and Western Europe. To learn more about WM and the company's sustainability progress and solutions,
visit <FONT STYLE="color: rgb(122,184,0)"><U>Sustainability.WM.com</U></FONT>.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 9pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; color: #57584f"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><I>&nbsp;</I></FONT></P>

or belief about current and future events, circumstances or performance. This press release contains a number of such forward-looking
statements, including all statements regarding financial guidance and achievement of 2026 guidance; future growth, earnings, value creation,
performance, cash flow generation, outlook, and results of our business; future share repurchases; and execution, results and benefits
from operational initiatives and investments. You should view these statements with caution. They are based on the facts and circumstances
known to the Company as of the date the statements are made. These forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties
that could cause actual results to be materially different from those set forth in such forward-looking statements, including but not
limited to, failure to implement our optimization, automation, growth, and cost savings initiatives and overall business strategy; failure
to obtain the results anticipated from strategic initiatives, investments, acquisitions, or new lines of business; failure to identify
acquisition targets, consummate and integrate acquisitions, including our ability to integrate the acquisition of Stericycle, Inc. (which
is now presented as our Healthcare Solutions segment) and achieve the anticipated benefits therefrom, including synergies; legal, regulatory,
operational, technological and other matters that may affect the costs and timing of our ability to integrate and deliver all of the
expected benefits of the Stericycle, Inc. acquisition; existing or new environmental and other regulations, including developments related
to emerging contaminants, gas emissions, renewable energy, recyclables, extended producer responsibility and our natural gas fleet; significant</P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="text-transform: uppercase"><B>Non-GAAP Financial Measures</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 11pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">To supplement its financial information, the Company
has presented, and/or may discuss on the conference call, adjusted measures including adjusted earnings per diluted share, adjusted net
income, adjusted income from operations and margin, adjusted operating EBITDA and margin, adjusted operating expense and margin, and
adjusted SG&amp;A expenses and margin. All adjusted measures and free cash flow are non-GAAP financial measures, as defined in Regulation
G of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended. The Company reports its financial results in compliance with GAAP but believes
that also discussing non-GAAP measures provides investors with (i) financial measures the Company uses in the management of its business
and (ii) additional, meaningful comparisons of current results to prior periods&rsquo; results by excluding items that the Company does
not believe reflect its fundamental business performance and are not representative or indicative of its results of operations.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company discusses free cash flow and provides
a projection of free cash flow because the Company believes that it is indicative of its ability to pay its quarterly dividends, repurchase
common stock, fund acquisitions and other investments and, in the absence of refinancings, to repay its debt obligations. The Company
believes free cash flow gives investors useful insight into how the Company views its liquidity, but the use of free cash flow as a liquidity
measure has material limitations because it excludes certain expenditures that are required or that the Company has committed to, such
as declared dividend payments and debt service requirements. The Company defines free cash flow as net cash provided by operating activities,
less capital expenditures, plus proceeds from divestitures of businesses and other assets (net of cash divested); this definition may
not be comparable to similarly-titled measures reported by other companies.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The quantitative reconciliations of non-GAAP measures
to the most comparable GAAP measures are included in the accompanying schedules, with the exception of projected adjusted operating EBITDA
and margin. Non-GAAP measures should not be considered a substitute for financial measures presented in accordance with GAAP.</P>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(b)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Represents amounts associated with business
                                            acquisitions consummated during the applicable period except where noted.</TD></TR></TABLE>

                                            rate based on actual dollars. When the effective tax rate is calculated by dividing the Tax
                                            Expense amount in the table above by the Pre-tax Income amount, differences occur due to
                                            rounding, as these items have been rounded in millions. The three months ended September
                                            30, 2026 and 2025 adjusted effective tax rates are 21.5% and 21.9%, respectively.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in; text-align: left">(d)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Beginning in 2026, landfill
                                            accretion expense was moved from operating expenses to depreciation, depletion, amortization
                                            and accretion. Landfill accretion expenses in the three months ended September 30, 2026 and
                                            2025 are $39 million and $35 million, respectively. For comparability purposes, 2025 results
                                            have been updated to reflect that change.</TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">(e)</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">The three months ended September 30, 2025
                                            includes (i) a $152 million impairment charge related to the decision to suspend the operations
                                            of a business; (ii) a $45 million impairment charge related to the decision to accelerate
                                            the closure of a landfill within our East Tier and (iii) an $11 million negotiated payment
                                            for early termination of a contract in our Renewable Energy segment.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in">Diversity in the structure
of recycling contracts results in different accounting treatment for commodity rebates. In accordance with revenue recognition guidance,
our Company records gross recycling revenue and records rebates paid to customers as cost of goods sold. Other contract structures allow
for netting of rebates against revenue.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

has been provided to enhance comparability and is not intended to replace or adjust GAAP reported results.</P>
